Time Zone: All times are in UTC+3 (Broker Time). Star (★) indicates that a 15:30 news occurred before this 17:00 news. Ranges are shown normalized as a multiple of trailing 14-day ATR, alongside raw USD. FULL % carries a 90% Wilson interval; RECENT (Bayes) is a beta-binomial posterior — a weak prior from the full-history rate, updated by the recent occurrences — not a raw recent percentage, since small samples like n=4 are unreliable on their own.
